steps: To start, choose the maximum 5 cards from red, orange cards and place them on 'PRE-GAME 1-5' zone. Warm colour sections are pre-game timeline.
On the 'MEASURE' sector on top-right, decide experiment subject by placing choosing the 'Measure' cards and place on middle section of board.
Choose the maximum 5 cards from orange, yellow cards and place them on 'PRE-GAME 6-10' zone.
From 'SERIOUS-GAMING' sector, Timeline changes to in-game. Pick the maximum 5 cards from green and blue types and place them on 'GAMING 1-5' zone.
On the 'MEASURE AGAIN' sector, refer back to the 'Measure' cards for experiment subject after the game.
Finally, pick the maximum 5 cards from purple cards and place on 'POST-GAME' zone to finish planning your experiment.
